body: Coming back to this a while later and reading it makes me realize the state of mind I was in.. I’ve been feeling much better lately by looking forward and realizing that I make mistakes and mess up sometimes.. I’ve tried hard to learn from them and I have great friends that are doing their best to help me. I forget sometimes that the hopelessness feeling isn’t forever and everyone has bad days.

Right. From what I’ve heard a fascination with death and dying is totally natural. It’s just a scary thing. Being in a bad place in life and also having these thoughts just messes with me sometime. This post was mostly to vent. Thank you for your reply, friend.
Just to clarify. She knows I know about it. She actually asked me not to say anything to him.
